The two primary M&M's spokescandies are Red and Yellow. Red is the sarcastic, cynical one, and Yellow is the naive, good-natured one. The team note offers "Red and Yellow" or "Peanut and Plain" as the possible answers, and Red and Yellow matches what I know. Yellow is the Peanut M&M and Red is the Plain M&M, so the two pairs name the same two characters.
